Here’s the simple version: ## Which policy applies when something goes wrong after buying? ### 1. If the issue is “Where is my order?” That’s usually a shipping issue. Cartwheel’s shipping policy says stores ship orders within 3 days of purchase, standard delivery takes up to 7 days in transit after shipment, and tracking appears on the order page once the store marks the order shipped. Policy: cw-shipping So examples that fall under shipping: The order has not shipped yet. Tracking is missing. Tracking has not updated. Delivery is taking longer than expected. ### 2. If the issue is “I got it, but I don’t want it / it’s not right for me” That’s usually a return issue. Cartwheel’s return policy says items can be returned within 30 days of delivery, and the clock starts from the delivery date, not the purchase date. Items must be in the condition described by the store’s listing. Some individual stores may have their own overrides, so the store’s policy can matter too. Policy: cw-returns So examples that fall under returns: You received the item and want to send it back. It does not fit your needs. You changed your mind, assuming the item/store allows returns. The item needs to be returned within the return window. ### 3. If the issue is “Will I get money back?” That’s a refund issue. Cartwheel’s refund policy says approved refunds go back to the original payment method and usually arrive in 5 to 10 business days. Refunds of $100 or less can process automatically once the order passes the eligibility check. Refunds above $100 are reviewed by a human support agent before money moves. Policy: cw-refunds So examples that fall under refunds: A return is approved and money needs to go back. An order is canceled and eligible for refund. A support issue is approved for refund. The refund amount is high enough that a human must review it. ## Who decides what happens? It depends on the case: The store handles shipping the order and marking it shipped, which makes tracking available. Policy: cw-shipping Cartwheel’s support assistant can help with questions about orders, returns, refunds, products, and platform policy. Policy: cw-getting-help If the assistant cannot resolve the case, Cartwheel opens a ticket for a human support agent, who responds within 24 hours. Policy: cw-getting-help For refunds, the order has to pass an eligibility check first. Refunds of $100 or less can be automatic after that check, while refunds over $100 go to a human support agent for review. Policy: cw-refunds ## A quick way to think about it Before it arrives → shipping policy: cw-shipping After it arrives and you want to send it back → return policy: cw-returns Money going back to you → refund policy: cw-refunds If the situation is unclear or needs judgment → Cartwheel support or a human agent: cw-getting-help If you want, you can tell me what happened with your specific order — like “it hasn’t shipped,” “it arrived damaged,” “I want to return it,” or “I’m waiting on a refund” — and I can help figure out which path applies.
